```{r Time Dependent ROC}
plot_time_dependent_roc <- function(cox_model, newdata, time_var, event_var,
                                    times = c(365, 1095, 1825),
                                    time_labels = c("1 year", "3 years", "5 years"),
                                    palette = c("#E87A90", "#2EA9DF", "#91B493")) {
  # Risk Scores
  lp <- predict(cox_model, newdata = newdata, type = "lp")
  
  # Construct timeROC Object
  roc_multi <- timeROC(
    T = newdata[[time_var]],
    delta = newdata[[event_var]],
    marker = lp,
    cause = 1,
    times = times,
    iid = TRUE
  )
  
  # Label of AUC
  auc_values <- round(roc_multi$AUC, 3)
  time_labels_auc <- paste0(time_labels, " (AUC = ", auc_values, ")")
  
  # Prepare Dataframe
  roc_df <- data.frame(
    fpr = c(roc_multi$FP[,1], roc_multi$FP[,2], roc_multi$FP[,3]),
    tpr = c(roc_multi$TP[,1], roc_multi$TP[,2], roc_multi$TP[,3]),
    time = factor(rep(time_labels_auc, each = nrow(roc_multi$FP)), levels = time_labels_auc)
  )
  
  # Plotting
  p <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = time)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#787D7B") +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, name = "Time Horizon") +
    labs(
      title = "Time-dependent ROC Curve with AUC",
      x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
      y = "True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"), 
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),             
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),             
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), 
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14)               
      )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r Oncotype Score}
               "Recurrence" = "#F596AA")
    ) + 
      labs(
        x = "Recurrence Status",
        y = "Oncotype Score",
        title = "Oncotype Score Distribution by Recurrence"
        ) +
      theme_minimal()

# Cox Regression 
Onco_cox <- coxph(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ 
                    Oncotype_score + I(Oncotype_score^2) + 
                    strata(Race) + Surgery_type, data = Onco)
summary(Onco_cox)
cox.zph(Onco_cox)
plot(cox.zph(Onco_cox))

plot_time_dependent_roc(
  cox_model = Onco_cox,
  newdata = Onco,
  time_var = "Time_to_event",
  event_var = "Recurrence"
)

# Logistic Regression
```

```{r Summary Table of Cox Regression}
create_cox_gt_table <- function(cox_model, selected_vars = NULL,
                                title = "Cox Regression Summary Table",
                                subtitle_all = "Rows with different significant level",
                                subtitle_subset = "Rows with different significant level (partial results shown)",
                                p_cut = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1)) {
  # ---- 1. 提取 summary ----
  cox_sum <- summary(cox_model)
  
  # 行名（模型矩阵中的参数名）
  term_names <- rownames(cox_sum$coefficients)
  
  # 基础表
  tbl <- data.frame(
    term   = term_names,
    Coef   = cox_sum$coefficients[, "coef"],
    HR     = cox_sum$coefficients[, "exp(coef)"],
    Lower  = cox_sum$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
    Upper  = cox_sum$conf.int[, "upper .95"],
    P_value= cox_sum$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # ---- 2. 模型中的 factor 原始 levels ----
  # cox_model$xlevels 是一个命名 list：每个因子变量对应一个字符向量的 levels
  xlv <- cox_model$xlevels  # may be empty if无factor
  var_names <- names(xlv)
  
  # ---- 3. 为每个 term 猜测对应原始变量名 & level ----
  # 如果模型里没有因子（xlv为空），这一段也能正常运行（都会标记 numeric）
  
  parse_term <- function(term) {
    # 找所有变量名中是 term 前缀的
    candidates <- var_names[startsWith(term, var_names)]
    if (length(candidates) == 0) {
      # 没匹配上 → 可能是 numeric 或 transformed term（如 poly）
      return(list(var = term, level = NA_character_, is_factor = FALSE))
    } else {
      # 如果多个匹配（如 Race 与 RaceCat），取最长匹配避免误拆
      var <- candidates[which.max(nchar(candidates))]
      suffix <- trimws(sub(var, "", term, fixed = TRUE))
      return(list(var = var,
                  level = suffix,
                  is_factor = TRUE))
    }
  }
  
  parsed <- map(term_names, parse_term)
  tbl$Var_raw   <- map_chr(parsed, "var")
  tbl$Level_raw <- map_chr(parsed, "level")
  tbl$is_factor <- map_lgl(parsed, "is_factor")
  
  # ---- 4. 构造 Reference 和 Level 显示文字 ----
  # 对 factor：参考组 = levels[[1]]（模型基准）
  # 对 numeric：Reference = 'Continuous'
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    mutate(
      Reference = case_when(
        is_factor ~ map_chr(Var_raw, ~ if (.x %in% names(xlv)) xlv[[.x]][1] else NA_character_),
        TRUE      ~ "Continuous"
      ),
      # Level 展示（对 factor 行显示被比较的 level；对 numeric 留空）
      Level = case_when(
        is_factor ~ Level_raw,
        TRUE      ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  # ---- 5. 人类可读：组合显示（Var = Level）----
  # 当 Level_raw 是空字符串（某些复杂模型）就不加等号
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = case_when(
        is_factor & nzchar(Level_raw) ~ paste0(Var_raw, " = ", Level_raw),
        TRUE ~ Var_raw
      ),
      Reference = case_when(
        is_factor ~ paste0(Var_raw, " = ", Reference),
        TRUE      ~ Reference
      )
    )
  
  # ---- 6. 筛选用户需要的变量（selected_vars 可写 Var_raw 或 term） ----
  if (!is.null(selected_vars)) {
    # 支持用户传 term 名称 或 原始变量名
    tbl <- tbl %>%
      filter(term %in% selected_vars | Var_raw %in% selected_vars)
  }
  
  # ---- 7. 格式化数字 & CI 列 ----
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    mutate(
      Coef = round(Coef, 3),
      HR   = round(HR, 3),
      Lower= round(Lower, 3),
      Upper= round(Upper, 3),
      P_value = round(P_value, 3),
      CI = sprintf("(%0.3f, %0.3f)", Lower, Upper)
    ) %>%
    select(Variable, Reference, HR, CI, P_value, Coef, term, Var_raw, Level_raw)
  
  # ---- 8. Significance Code ----
  # cut: <0.001, <0.01, <0.05, <0.1
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    mutate(
      Signif = case_when(
        P_value < p_cut[1] ~ "***",
        P_value < p_cut[2] ~ "**",
        P_value < p_cut[3] ~ "*",
        P_value < p_cut[4] ~ ".",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      SigBin = case_when(
        P_value < p_cut[1] ~ 1,
        P_value < p_cut[2] ~ 2,
        P_value < p_cut[3] ~ 3,
        P_value < p_cut[4] ~ 4,
        TRUE ~ 5
      )
    )
  
  # ---- 9. 构建 gt 表 ----
  gt_table <- tbl %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title = title,
      subtitle = ifelse(is.null(selected_vars), subtitle_all, subtitle_subset)
    ) %>%
    cols_label(
      Variable  = "Variable",
      Reference = "Reference",
      HR        = "Hazard Ratio",
      CI        = "95% CI",
      P_value   = "P-value",
      Coef      = "Coef",
      Signif    = "Sig"
    ) %>%
    # 把调试列隐藏（term / Var_raw / Level_raw / SigBin）
    cols_hide(columns = c(term, Var_raw, Level_raw, SigBin)) %>%
    # 根据显著性着色（SigBin）
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = "#FFB6C1"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = Signif == "***")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = "#FFD2DC"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = Signif == "**")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = list(cell_fill(color = "#FFE4EB"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_body(rows = Signif == "*")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#FFF0F5"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = Signif == ".")
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_body(rows = P_value < 0.1)
      ) %>% 
    # 列标题对齐
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(align = "center"),
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(HR, CI, P_value, Coef, Signif))
    ) %>%
    # 列内容对齐
    cols_align(align = "left",  columns = c(Variable, Reference)) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(HR, CI, P_value, Coef, Signif)) %>% 
    # 隐藏Signif列
    cols_hide(columns = c(Coef,Signif))
  
  return(gt_table)
}
```


```{r Neoadjuvant Therapy and Adjuvant Therapy}
## Difference of Survival Time about Neoadjuvant
table(cleaned_data$Neoadjuvant, cleaned_data$Recurrence)
chisq.test(table(cleaned_data$Neoadjuvant, cleaned_data$Recurrence))

# cleaned_data$Time_to_event <- (cleaned_data$Time_to_event) / 365
Neo_kep <- survfit(Surv(Time_to_event/365, Recurrence) ~ Neoadjuvant,
                   data = cleaned_data %>% mutate(Recurrence = ifelse(Recurrence == "Recurrence", 1, 0)))

ggsurvplot(
    Neo_kep,
    data = cleaned_data %>% mutate(Recurrence = ifelse(Recurrence == "Recurrence", 1, 0)),
    pval = TRUE,
    font.main = c(21, "bold", "black"),       
    font.x = c(18, "plain", "black"),         
    font.y = c(18, "plain", "black"),         
    font.tickslab = c(18, "plain", "black"),  
    font.legend = c(18, "plain", "black"),
    xlab = "Time (Years)",
    title = "Kaplan-Meier Curve for Neoadjuvant Therapy",
    xlim = c(0, 10),
    break.time.by = 1
) 

# ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(Time_to_event, Recurrence) ~ 1, data = Neo), data = Neo,
#            risk.table = TRUE,
#            title = "Overall Survival Curve",
#            xlab = "Time to Event (days)")

## Subgroup of Patients with Neoadjuvant therapy
Neo <- cleaned_data %>% filter(
  Neoadjuvant == "Yes",
  Surgery == 1
) %>% select(
  -Metastatic,
  -Days_to_death,
  -Oncotype_score
) %>% mutate(
  Nottingham_grade = case_when(
    Nottingham_score <= 5 ~ "Grade 1",
    Nottingham_score <= 7 ~ "Grade 2",
    Nottingham_score <= 9 ~ "Grade 3",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  Nottingham_grade = factor(Nottingham_grade, levels = c("Grade 1", "Grade 2", "Grade 3")),
  Recurrence = ifelse(Recurrence == "Recurrence", 1, 0),
  T_stage = factor(T_stage, ordered = F),
  N_stage = factor(N_stage, ordered = F)
)

vis_miss(Neo, cluster = T, sort_miss = T)

# General Therapy
table(Neo$Chemo, Neo$Recurrence)
table(Neo$Radiation, Neo$Recurrence)

# Specific Therapy
table(Neo$Antiher2, Neo$Recurrence)
table(Neo$Endocrine, Neo$Recurrence)

Neo <- Neo %>%
  mutate(
    Chemo = case_when(
      Chemo %in% c("Adjuvant Only", "Both") ~ "Adjuvant",
      Chemo %in% c("Neoadjuvant Only", "None") ~ "No Adjuvant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Radiation = case_when(
      Radiation %in% c("Adjuvant Only", "Both") ~ "Adjuvant",
      Radiation %in% c("Neoadjuvant Only", "None") ~ "No Adjuvant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Antiher2 = case_when(
      Antiher2 %in% c("Adjuvant Only", "Both") ~ "Adjuvant",
      Antiher2 %in% c("Neoadjuvant Only", "None") ~ "No Adjuvant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Endocrine = case_when(
      Endocrine %in% c("Adjuvant Only", "Both") ~ "Adjuvant",
      Endocrine %in% c("Neoadjuvant Only", "None") ~ "No Adjuvant",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Perfect Prediction for Pathologic Response
table(Neo$Pathologic_response, Neo$Recurrence)
# Neo <- Neo %>% filter(Pathologic_response != "Complete")

table(Neo$Clinical_response, Neo$Recurrence)
table(Neo$Near_response_strict, Neo$Recurrence)
table(Neo$Near_response_loose, Neo$Recurrence)

table(Neo$Patho_N_stage, Neo$Recurrence)
table(Neo$Patho_T_stage, Neo$Recurrence)
  
# survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Nottingham_grade, data = Neo)

# Cox Regression for Treatment Adjusted with Characteristics at Diagnose and Response
Neo_cox <- coxph(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ 
                   Race + T_stage + N_stage + Nottingham_score + 
                   Surgery_type + Time_to_surgery + 
                   Chemo + Radiation + 
                   Clinical_response, data = Neo)

# Contents of the Table
table_data <- data.frame(
  Module = c("Demographic", 
             "Characteristics at Diagnosis", 
             "Treatment", 
             "Response After Neoadjuvant"),
  Variables = c(
    "Race",
    "T stage, N stage, Nottingham score",
    "Surgery type, Time to surgery, Chemo, Radiation",
    "Clinical response"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Colors of the Chunk
fill_colors <- c("#B2CFE5", "#F9DBBD", "#C2EABD", "#F6B3B3")

# Creating the Objects
colored_table <- tableGrob(table_data, rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_default(
    core = list(
      bg_params = list(fill = fill_colors, col = NA),
      fg_params = list(fontsize = 16)
    ),
    colhead = list(
      bg_params = list(fill = "grey90", col = NA),
      fg_params = list(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
)

# Plotting
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(colored_table)

summary(Neo_cox)
cox.zph(Neo_cox)
plot(cox.zph(Neo_cox))

plot_time_dependent_roc(
  cox_model = Neo_cox,
  newdata = Neo,
  time_var = "Time_to_event",
  event_var = "Recurrence"
)

ggforest(Neo_cox, 
         data = Neo,
         fontsize = 1.2)

selected_vars <- c("T_stage2", "T_stage3", "T_stage4",
                   "N_stage1", "N_stage2", "N_stage3",
                   "ChemoNo Adjuvant", "RadiationNo Adjuvant",
                   "Clinical_responseComplete")

create_cox_gt_table(Neo_cox, selected_vars = selected_vars)


## Subgroup of Patients with Adjuvant therapy
Nonneo <- cleaned_data %>% filter(
  Neoadjuvant == "No",
  Surgery == 1) %>% select(
    -Surgery,
    -Neoadjuvant,
    -Clinical_response,
    -Pathologic_response,
    -Patho_T_stage,
    -Patho_N_stage,
    -Patho_M_stage,
    -Near_response_strict,
    -Near_response_loose,
    -Near_response_grade,
    -Days_to_death
    ) %>% mutate(
      Chemo = factor(Chemo, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
      Radiation = factor(Radiation, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
      Antiher2 = factor(Antiher2, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
      Endocrine = factor(Endocrine, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
      T_stage = factor(T_stage, ordered = F),
      N_stage = factor(N_stage, ordered = F),
      Recurrence = ifelse(Recurrence == "Recurrence", 1, 0)
    )

vis_miss(Nonneo, cluster = T, sort_miss = T)

# Antiher2 is not Helpful
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Chemo, data = Nonneo)
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Radiation, data = Nonneo)
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Antiher2, data = Nonneo)
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Endocrine, data = Nonneo)

table(Nonneo$T_stage, Nonneo$Recurrence)
table(Nonneo$N_stage, Nonneo$Recurrence)

# Cox Regression
Nonneo_cox <- coxph(Surv(time = Time_to_event, event = Recurrence) ~ 
                      strata(Race) + strata(Mole_type) +
                      Nottingham_score + 
                      Surgery_type + Time_to_surgery +
                      Chemo + Radiation + Antiher2 + Endocrine, data = Nonneo)
summary(Nonneo_cox)
cox.zph(Nonneo_cox)
plot(cox.zph(Nonneo_cox))

plot_time_dependent_roc(
  cox_model = Nonneo_cox,
  newdata = Nonneo,
  time_var = "Time_to_event",
  event_var = "Recurrence"
)

create_cox_gt_table(Nonneo_cox)
```


```{r Molecular Type and Therapy}
# cleaned_data$Mole_type
table(cleaned_data$Mole_type, cleaned_data$Antiher2)
table(cleaned_data$Mole_type, cleaned_data$Endocrine)

## Subgroup by Molecular Type and adjusted for Neoadjuvant Therapy
# Luminal Like
Luminal_Like <- cleaned_data %>% filter(
  Neoadjuvant == "No",
  Mole_type == 0,
  Surgery == 1,
  T_stage != 4 
) %>% mutate(
  Recurrence = ifelse(Recurrence == "Recurrence", 1, 0),
  Chemo = factor(Chemo, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
  Radiation = factor(Radiation, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
  Antiher2 = factor(Antiher2, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
  Endocrine = factor(Endocrine, levels = c("Adjuvant Only", "None")),
  T_stage = factor(T_stage, ordered = F),
  N_stage = factor(N_stage, ordered = F)
  )

# Endocrine Therapy Works
Luminal_kep <- survfit(Surv(Time_to_event, Recurrence) ~ Endocrine, data = Luminal_Like)
ggsurvplot(Luminal_kep,
           data = Luminal_Like,
           pval = T)

survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Chemo, data = Luminal_Like)
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Radiation, data = Luminal_Like)
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ T_stage, data = Luminal_Like)
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ N_stage, data = Luminal_Like)

# Cox Regression
Luminal_cox <- coxph(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ 
                   strata(Race) + Surgery_type + Time_to_surgery + 
                   Nottingham_score + N_stage + T_stage + 
                   Chemo + Radiation + Endocrine, data = Luminal_Like)

summary(Luminal_cox)
cox.zph(Luminal_cox)
plot(cox.zph(Luminal_cox))

plot_time_dependent_roc(
  cox_model = Luminal_cox,
  newdata = Luminal_Like,
  time_var = "Time_to_event",
  event_var = "Recurrence"
)

# selected_vars <- c("Surgery_type", "Time_to_surgery", "Nottingham_score",
#                                    "N_stage", "T_stage", "Endocrine")
create_cox_gt_table(Luminal_cox)

# Ovarian Status Known
Luminal_Ovarian <- Luminal_Like %>% filter(Ovarian_status == "Yes")

# Oophorectomy Not Significant
Ovarian_kep <- survfit(Surv(Time_to_event, Recurrence) ~ Oophorectomy, data = Luminal_Ovarian)
ggsurvplot(Ovarian_kep,
           data = Luminal_Ovarian,
           pval = T)

survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Endocrine, data = Luminal_Ovarian)

# ER/PR+ HER2+
ERPRpos_HER2pos <- cleaned_data %>% filter(
  Mole_type == 1,

) %>% mutate(
  Recurrence = ifelse(Recurrence == "Recurrence", 1, 0),
  Endocrine = case_when(
    Endocrine %in% c("Adjuvant Only", "Both") ~ "Adjuvant",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
  Antiher2 = case_when(
    Antiher2 %in% c("Adjuvant Only", "Both") ~ "Adjuvant",
    Antiher2 %in% c("Neoadjuvant Only", "None") ~ "No Adjuvant",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Antiher2, data = ERPRpos_HER2pos)
```

```{r Ovarian Status Known}
## Subgroup of Patients whose Ovarian Status are Known
Ova <- cleaned_data %>% filter(
  Ovarian_status == "Yes"
) %>% mutate(
  Recurrence = ifelse(Recurrence == "Recurrence", 1, 0),
  Endocrine = case_when(
    Endocrine %in% c("Adjuvant Only", "Both") ~ "Adjuvant",
    Endocrine %in% c("Neoadjuvant Only", "None") ~ "No Adjuvant",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
  Ovary_count = factor(Ovary_count, ordered = F)
  )

## Clinical Considerations about Oophorectomy
# Oophorectomy is Dependent with Molecular Type and Age
fisher.test(table(Ova$Oophorectomy,Ova$Mole_type))

ggplot(Ova, aes(x = Oophorectomy, y = Age, fill = Oophorectomy)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +  
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Yes" = "#58B2DC",
               "No" = "#F596AA")
    ) + 
      labs(
        x = "Oophorectomy or Not",
        y = "Age",
        title = "Age Distribution by Oophorectomy"
        ) +
      theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),   
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),                
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),                
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)                 
  )

wilcox.test(Age ~ Oophorectomy, data = Ova)

# Adjusted for Age Group
Ova <- Ova %>%
  mutate(
    Age_group = cut(Age,
                    breaks = c(0, 45, 55, 100),
                    labels = c("Young", "Middle-aged", "Older")),
    T_stage = factor(T_stage, ordered = F),
    N_stage = factor(N_stage, ordered = F)
  ) %>% select(
    Age, Age_group, everything()
  )

table(Ova$Age_group,Ova$Recurrence)
table((Ova %>% filter(Age_group != "Older"))$T_stage, (Ova %>% filter(Age_group != "Older"))$Recurrence)
table((Ova %>% filter(Age_group != "Older"))$N_stage, (Ova %>% filter(Age_group != "Older"))$Recurrence)

# Both are Not Significant
survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Endocrine, 
         data = Ova %>% filter(Age_group == "Middle-aged"))

survdiff(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~ Oophorectomy, 
         data = Ova %>% filter(Age_group == "Middle-aged"))

# Cox Regression with Detailed Age Variable
Ova_cox <- coxph(Surv(time = as.numeric(Time_to_event), event = Recurrence) ~
                   Age + strata(Mole_type) + T_stage + N_stage + 
                   Endocrine + strata(Ovary_count) + Oophorectomy, 
                 data = Ova %>% filter(Age_group != "Older"))

summary(Ova_cox)
cox.zph(Ova_cox)
```
